definitions.explanation: A rope or string that is swung over and under the body while jumping. Also refers to the activity of jumping rope.

examples.japanese: {縄跳|なわと}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百回|ひゃっかい}⟦{跳|と}んだ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧。
examples.english: I jumped rope a hundred times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{縄跳|なわと}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We did jump rope in physical education class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{縄跳|なわと}び⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}えて→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I train my body with jump rope every morning.

notes:
{縄跳|なわと}び refers to both the rope and the activity of jumping rope.

TYPES OF JUMPS:
- ⟦{前跳|まえと}び→前跳び：noentry⟧ (forward jump)
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ{跳|と}び→後ろ跳び：noentry⟧ (backward jump)
- ⟦{二重跳|にじゅうと}び→二重跳び：29569_nijuutobi⟧ (double under)
- ⟦{交差跳|こうさと}び→交差跳び：noentry⟧ (cross jump)
- ⟦{片足跳|かたあしと}び→片足跳び：noentry⟧ (single-leg jump)

GROUP ACTIVITIES:
- ⟦{大縄|おおなわ}→大縄：noentry⟧: long rope for group jumping
- ⟦{大縄跳|おおなわと}び→大縄跳び：29570_oonawatobi⟧: group jump rope activity

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {縄跳|なわと}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to jump rope)
- {縄跳|なわと}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{跳|と}ぶ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧ (to jump rope)

USAGE IN SCHOOLS:
Jump rope is commonly used in Japanese elementary schools as part of physical education. It's often practiced during winter to stay warm.
